text: Decision
POST /decisions
Authorized human decision with reason/evidence context.
RBAC + object scope: tenant/company/vessel/tug/role; ABAC can add assignment/state restrictions.
Master/Tug Master onboard decisions require role + current vessel assignment, not only global role.
DPA fleet visibility and escalation rights separate from vessel operational approval.
Protected reporting identity is restricted to designated reviewers.
HumanDecision
subject_type/id, decision, actor_role, actor_id, reason, evidence_context, decided_at
One screen = one primary question; manage by exception
Navigasyon
Sidebar + menu search; focused/full mode; role/mode-aware visibility
Kayıt UX
Kaydet sağ üst; satır aksiyonları üç nokta; bulk actions; full-page over drawer for complex flows
Safety UX
Critical blocker hiçbir skor/ortalama tarafından gizlenmez
1. UX İlkeleri
Role-first: kullanıcıya tüm sistemi değil, rolünün o anda yapması gereken işi göster.
